Two weeks later I realize after applying the toner it does leave a few dry patches on my skin, but its ok because  I also use the vitamin C serum after. I do see a t change in my pores. reviews.t: Vitamin C Facial Toner - Visual Difference in Pores
reviews.x: I purchased the Vitamen C Toner because I've been using the Vitamen C Serum with several serums from Tree of Life Beauty and I love them all.  My hope was the toner would give my skin a deeper clean after washing and before applying serums - and I have seen a visible difference in just a few weeks.  This is a buy again and again product for me.

reviews.t: SECOND PURCHASE!!! Great for my sensitive skin!!
reviews.x: This is my second purchase of this toner. It’s gentle enough for me to use morning and night, and I have sensitive skin. I also like the lid, because it helps you not waste the product!

I have tried many skin care products in the past. I have visible pores on my cheeks and nose. With the Tree Of Life Beauty skin care, my skin is improving tremendously. This toner is improving the texture of my skin.  I use half of a cotton ball and about 6 drops of the toner. A little goes a long way. Fabulous packaging and shipping. I am now a life long customer.
Improved the look of my pores more than a very expensive regimine.  Skin is brighter and prepped for a Tree of Life moisturizer after this.

claims.text: Many reviewers with sensitive skin report the toner is mild and non-irritating.
Reviewers frequently say the toner leaves their skin soft, smooth, and glowing.
Several reviewers say it helped clear or minimize their acne and breakouts.
A few reviewers note initial breakouts or adjustment before their skin settled.
One reviewer questions the ingredients and plans to return the product.
